param: δt Discrete-time step length (quarter of a day) used in the transmission model update equations
λ(t) Force of infection at time t (per-susceptible infection hazard), frequency-dependent, proportional to infectious prevalence
β Transmission rate parameter (rate at which new infections take place given a contact); used in λ(t)=β I(t)/N
σ Daily rate of progression through latent (exposed) stages: E₁→E₂ and E₂→I₁ (implies mean incubation period d_L = 2*(1/σ) days)
γ Daily rate of progression through infectious stages: I₁→I₂ and I₂→R (implies mean infectious period d_I = 2*(1/γ) days)
N Total population size for the season (fixed within season; use N_year value at simulation time)
N2012/13 Population size used for season 2012/13
N2013/14 Population size used for season 2013/14
N2014/15 Population size used for season 2014/15
